description: Land Acquisition - Meddeketiya, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes (Central Expressway Project), including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, extents, and claimant information. The content falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters.
